# AL.com

> > AL.com is Alabama's premier news and classified advertising platform, featuring local news, sports, and marketplace services including automotive listings across Birmingham and statewide communities.

AL.com serves as the digital hub for Alabama residents, providing comprehensive news coverage, community information, and classified advertising services. The platform connects buyers and sellers throughout Alabama, with a strong focus on the Birmingham metropolitan area and surrounding regions.
